rca_of_issue: Bug found: Delivery partner city-based assignment was failing due to NameError at server.py line 354. The code referenced undefined variable 'tailor.get('city')' instead of 'user.get('city')' when filtering delivery partners. Root cause: Copy-paste error or incorrect variable reference. Impact: 500 error when tailor accepts order, preventing delivery partner assignment. Fix applied: Changed 'tailor.get('city', '')' to 'user.get('city', '')' since 'user' is the authenticated tailor accepting the order. Verified working via pytest.
